NER.note: Document states no census or survey for Niger.

facts.fact: Niger's National Communication Observatory (ONC) said on 8 May 2026 it was suspending nine France-based outlets (France 24, RFI, AFP, TV5Monde, Jeune Afrique, Mediapart, TF1 Info, LSI Africa, France Afrique Media) over content it said threatened public order, as reported by CPJ.
CPJ reports the ONC suspended nine outlets from reaching audiences in Niger, with a France 24 channel screen showing 'program blocked'.
